product.description: EduPlay LogicQuest 50 is a family‑friendly board game that blends strategy, memory, and problem‑solving in a compact, colorful package. Players navigate a 50 cm square board, collecting clues and solving puzzles to reach the finish line first. The game includes 200 high‑contrast cards, a reusable wooden token set, and a sturdy cardboard box with a built‑in storage drawer. Designed for ages 8 and up, it encourages critical thinking and teamwork while providing a light‑hearted competitive experience.
